CanonicalSourceUri.description: Canonical absolute URI serialization: lowercase scheme, ASCII URI characters, and valid percent escapes only.

RowAxisKind.description: How a dataframe's row axis is presented without exposing it as ordinary columns.

levelNames.description: Ordered row-axis level names. Null represents an unnamed level.

SessionDataShape.description: Live-session shape. A null row count means the backend deliberately has not run a full count.

rowLabel.description: Optional source row label. rowNumber remains the zero-based logical grid position.

columnIds.description: Ordered stable identities for projected row values.

UnknownTotalGridPage.description: A bounded live page whose distributed backend has not run a full count.

columnIds.description: Ordered stable identities for projected row values.

TypedSelectionToken.description: Typed representative for a distinct-value group whose display text alone is ambiguous.

sort.description: Ordered viewing sorts. TypeScript and Python decoders enforce that each column appears at most once; JSON Schema uniqueItems rejects identical rule objects.

FillMissingFallbackColumnReferenceArray.description: Ordered fallback columns for a same-row fill. Earlier columns have higher priority.

delimiter.description: A non-empty literal delimiter; regular-expression interpretation is never used.

newColumns.description: Ordered output names. Parts beyond this fixed output count are ignored.

pattern.description: A case-sensitive portable regular-expression pattern. The first leftmost match is used; unsupported dialect constructs are rejected before dispatch.

group.description: Capture group to return. Group 0 selects the complete match.

newColumn.description: A single-line portable output name of at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes; exact byte validation is enforced by every decoder.

columns.description: Ordered compatible scalar columns. Output rows are grouped by this selected-column order and preserve source order within each group.

labelColumn.description: Name of the stable string output containing each selected public column name; exact UTF-8 byte validation is enforced by every decoder.

valueColumn.description: Name of the scalar output containing the selected values without lossy common-type coercion; exact UTF-8 byte validation is enforced by every decoder.

key.description: A versioned, present string selection token matching one exact names-from value.

name.description: An explicit output name. Exact UTF-8 byte and portable collision validation is enforced by every decoder.

namesFrom.description: A portable text or factor scalar whose complete non-null domain must be declared by outputs.

valuesFrom.description: A distinct compatible scalar column copied without aggregation or common-type coercion.

outputs.description: Ordered fixed outputs. Duplicate identifier-and-key rows are errors; missing declared combinations become typed nulls.

rDataframeFlavor.description: Required only for a confirmed live R session; forbidden for every other backend.

RowAxisExportPolicy.description: Explicit Pandas CSV/Parquet export treatment for the dataframe index.

CsvExportOptions.description: Explicit CSV serialization choices. The host offers confirmed import options as defaults without making them immutable.

delimiter.description: Exactly one non-NUL, non-line-break Unicode scalar value, distinct from quoteChar.

quoteChar.description: Exactly one non-NUL, non-line-break Unicode scalar value, distinct from delimiter.

ParquetExportOptions.description: Parquet serialization choices. CSV-only dialect fields are invalid.
